headline: Pritish Nandy Communications files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure
sum: Pritish Nandy Communications Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in the company. The specific acquirer, consideration, and shareholding threshold crossed are not disclosed in the publicly available filing summary.
detail: Pritish Nandy Communications Limited, listed on NSE, has submitted the mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the exchange as required under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure indicates that a substantial acquisition event has occurred. The filing is a regulatory milestone in the acquisition process, but the full commercial and legal terms-acquirer identity, acquisition price, number of shares, and timeline-are contained in the detailed disclosure document referenced but not excerpted in the Bar & Bench report. Under Indian takeover law, this disclosure typically triggers a 30-day statutory window for open offer filing if the acquisition crosses the 25% threshold.
